data.headline: Raise price 3% now and build 4 extra weeks of stock
data.why: The figures above show this plan adds the most profit over six months while keeping peak cash needs below the $12,000 on hand. News confirms Arabica futures are at multi-month highs and roasters are buying physical beans at higher prices, so locking in inventory now avoids larger cost jumps later.
data.watch_out: If the Brazil crop surprise is worse than expected, bean costs could spike another 15-20% and the extra stock would tie up cash right when replacement orders get expensive.
data.recheck_when: Re-check at the next USDA Brazil crop report or if Arabica futures jump another 5% from today's level.
